Failure frees all allocated bitmaps and zeroes shared state before retry; STATUS_NO_MEMORY becomes ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY. Success publishes process-lifetime immutable bitmaps; readiness preserves prior last-error on success.

Moving initializer wholesale to B would introduce B-to-C calls; moving all mirror algorithms to F discards original ownership. S14 should assess original C storage/declarations with F once/publication and rollback retained. Measure mirror points/lines before implementation and obtain approval for any increase.
